- Banned sellers' listings 404 `{error: 'not found'}` on PATCH exactly like `GET /:id` and the grid: the ownership SELECT must exclude rows whose seller has `is_banned = true` (reuse the in-file `JOIN users … WHERE u.is_banned = false` filter); a banned caller can never reach the ownership check because `sessionMiddleware` resolves their session to a null `c.var.user` and `requireAuth` 401s it [from: Q2]
- The PATCH test suite is appended to the existing `test/listings.test.ts` as one new `test(...)` describe-block-style group, reusing its module-level seeded `owner`/`other`/`banned` users and `ownerSession`/`bannedSession` (seed only a fresh `other` session with `seedSession`); no new `test/listings-patch.test.ts` file. Update the file's header comment to note that PATCH is now covered, keeping the existing "Also covered: …" style [from: Q3]
- Build only on the existing step 22/23/24 wiring: keep `listingsApp`'s existing handlers (`GET /`, `GET /:id`, `POST /`) and the `app.route('/api/listings', listingsApp)` chain in `src/server/index.ts` unchanged; add the PATCH handler to `listingsApp`, do not create a new route module or app, and do not alter `AppType` exports or the throwaway `/api/_ping` route [from: spec]
- Use the existing shared `listingUpdateSchema` from `src/shared/schema.ts` verbatim via `zValidator('json', listingUpdateSchema)` with its default 400 response on invalid bodies (add it to the existing named import from `../../shared/schema.ts`); do not add, rename, or reshape fields, and do not hand-write request/response types — server↔client types flow through `AppType` and the shared zod schemas [from: spec]
- Preserve the existing error-envelope conventions in `src/server/routes/listings.ts`: 401 `{error: 'unauthorized'}` from `requireAuth` for unauthenticated and banned sessions, 404 `{error: 'not found'}` for nonexistent, malformed (non-UUID), non-owner, and banned-seller ids, 400 from the validator's default for schema-invalid bodies [from: spec]
- Ownership check is server-side: the row's `seller_id` must equal `c.var.user.id`; another member's listing is not editable (404, matching the in-file convention — do not invent a 403 for non-owners) [from: spec]
- `updated_at` is set by the app on every UPDATE (no trigger): the UPDATE statement sets `updated_at = now()` (or the `sql`NOW()` fragment) explicitly, including for an empty-object body; tests must verify `updated_at` advances when the row is edited [from: spec]

- Keep the existing test-file structure in `test/`: per-file `process.env.DATABASE_URL` override before dynamic imports, `setupApiTest()`, and the `seedUser`/`seedSession`/`seedListing`/`queryFirst`/`appRequestJSON`/`sessionCookieHeaders` harness from `test/fixtures.ts`, `test/api.setup.ts`, and `test/helpers.ts`; rows persist across tests within a file (TRUNCATE runs in `afterAll`), so new tests must scope to uniquely-tagged seeds or exact ids [from: spec]
- Do not touch later-step artifacts: no `POST /api/listings/:id/sold`, `DELETE /api/listings/:id`, `GET /api/listings/:id/contact`, photos routes, `images.ts`, or any client pages/components; do not modify `package.json`, `tsconfig.json`, `eslint.config.js`, `db.ts`, `auth.ts`, or `src/shared/schema.ts` unless the route genuinely cannot be written without a one-line addition (the schema is already complete for this step — assume no schema change is needed) [from: spec]
- Code style: Prettier (`printWidth 120`, no semicolons, single quotes, 4-space indent), ESLint `no-explicit-any`/`no-shadow` errors, strict TypeScript — the change must pass `bun run lint` cleanly [from: spec]
- Test-first cadence: the PATCH tests land in the same change as the route; the route is not done until its tests exist and pass [from: spec]

spec:
GOAL

Create `src/server/images.ts`, a pure in-memory sharp 0.35 image-processing pipeline for listing photos, plus its same-change `bun test` suite in `test/images.test.ts` (test-first cadence: the module is done only when its tests exist and pass). Given an uploaded raw image buffer, the pipeline rejects inputs >15 MB pre-compression (throwing `ImageTooLargeError`) and inputs that are not decodable as jpeg/png/webp (throwing `UnsupportedImageError`, which is how HEIC fails — prebuilt sharp binaries lack HEIF decode), honors EXIF orientation via `sharp(buffer).rotate()`, strips all metadata, and returns in one pass both a full WebP rendition (longest edge 1600px, no upscale, `quality: 80`) and a thumb WebP rendition (longest edge 600px, no upscale, `quality: 72`). The returned buffers are what the later `POST /api/listings/:id/photos` handler (step 30) inserts as `listing_photos.full_data` / `thumb_data` / `byte_size` (`byte_size` = full rendition byte length, matching the `integer not null` column; `content_type` default is `image/webp`). This step does no database work, no HTTP routing, no file storage, and no per-listing count/position logic.

CONSTRAINTS

- Accept only jpeg/png/webp; no HEIC — prebuilt sharp binaries lack HEIF decode, so undecodable/HEIC input must be rejected, never silently coerced. [from: spec]
- Reject inputs >15 MB measured on the incoming pre-compression buffer, before any sharp work. [from: spec]
- Honor EXIF orientation via `sharp(buffer).rotate()` (orientation baked into pixels, orientation tag removed); strip all metadata from both outputs. [from: spec]
- Full rendition: resize longest edge to 1600px with no upscale (`resize(1600, 1600, { fit: 'inside', withoutEnlargement: true })`), `.webp({ quality: 80 })`. [from: spec]
- Thumb rendition: resize longest edge to 600px, `.webp({ quality: 72 })`. [from: spec]
- The thumb uses the same no-upscale semantics as the full: `resize(600, 600, { fit: 'inside', withoutEnlargement: true })` — a source smaller than 600px stays at its native size. [from: Q1]
- Export two thin, distinct error types extending `Error` with stable messages — `ImageTooLargeError` and `UnsupportedImageError` — thrown by the pipeline so step 30 can map them to 400 responses via `instanceof` (or fall back to the generic message). [from: Q2]
- Both outputs are WebP buffers; `byte_size` for the `listing_photos` consumer is the full rendition's byte length. [from: spec]
- No database, no HTTP routing, no file storage; no ≤5-per-listing enforcement and no `position`/cover handling here (those are pinned to the step-30 handler). [from: spec]
- No changes to `src/server/routes/`, `src/shared/schema.ts`, `src/server/db.ts`, `migrate.ts`, `auth.ts`, `index.ts`; no new tables, endpoints, pages, or components. [from: spec]
- Tests are pure in-memory (buffers generated via sharp itself): must pass under `AGENT=1 bun test` with no Postgres and must not import `test/api.setup.ts`, `test/fixtures.ts`, or `src/server/db.ts` (the preload pins `DATABASE_URL` process-wide; importing `db.ts` would bind it). [from: spec]
- Follow repo conventions: Prettier (no semicolons, single quotes, printWidth 120, `bracketSpacing: false`, `arrowParens: 'avoid'`, LF), ESLint `no-explicit-any: error` / `no-shadow: error`, strict TS (`noUncheckedIndexedAccess`, `noUnusedLocals/Parameters`). [from: spec]
- Test-first cadence (design §10): the `test/images.test.ts` suite lands in the same change as the module; the module is not done until its tests exist and pass. [from: spec]
- `import sharp from 'sharp'` is the canonical import; sharp is already in `package.json`/`bun.lock` — no install step. [from: spec]

ACCEPTANCE

- An oversized pre-compression buffer (>15 MB) is rejected before any sharp work with the exported `ImageTooLargeError` (an `instanceof Error`). [test: test/images.test.ts "rejects buffers over the 15 MB limit with ImageTooLargeError"]
- A buffer that sharp cannot decode as jpeg/png/webp (e.g. non-image bytes) is rejected with the exported `UnsupportedImageError` (an `instanceof Error`), not coerced. [test: test/images.test.ts "rejects undecodable input with UnsupportedImageError"]
- The pipeline honors EXIF orientation: a source with an EXIF orientation tag comes out with the orientation baked into pixels (output pixel dimensions swapped/consistent with the tag) and no orientation metadata in the output. [test: test/images.test.ts "honors EXIF orientation via rotate and strips metadata from outputs"]
- Full rendition: an input larger than 1600px on the long edge is resized so the longest edge is 1600px and the short edge is proportionally scaled, and the output is WebP. [test: test/images.test.ts "full rendition resizes to longest edge 1600px and outputs webp"]
- Full rendition no-upscale: an input whose longest edge is below 1600px is not upscaled — the full output keeps the source's native pixel dimensions. [test: test/images.test.ts "full rendition does not upscale an input smaller than 1600px"]
- Thumb rendition: a larger input is resized to longest edge 600px (short edge proportional) and is WebP. [test: test/images.test.ts "thumb rendition resizes to longest edge 600px and outputs webp"]
- Thumb no-upscale: an input smaller than 600px stays at its native size in the thumb (per Q1). [test: test/images.test.ts "thumb rendition does not upscale an input smaller than 600px"]
- The result object's `byteSize` equals the full rendition buffer's byte length (`full.length`), matching `listing_photos.byte_size`. [test: test/images.test.ts "result byteSize is the full rendition byte length"]
- `src/server/images.ts` exports the pipeline function and the two error types `ImageTooLargeError` and `UnsupportedImageError`. [static]
- `test/images.test.ts` exists and does not import `test/api.setup.ts`, `test/fixtures.ts`, or `src/server/db.ts` (no DB in the pipeline tests). [static]
- Type checking passes with no errors on the two new files (run directly via `bunx tsc --noEmit` against the repo `tsconfig.json`; there is no `typecheck` package script). [cmd: bunx tsc --noEmit]
- The repo `lint` script passes (it runs `bunx @tailwindcss/cli -i src/client/index.css -o dist/app.css && prettier --check . && bunx eslint . && bunx tsc --noEmit`). [cmd: bun run lint]
- The images suite passes under `bun test` with no Postgres reachable. [cmd: AGENT=1 bun test test/images.test.ts]

```sh
test -f test/images.test.ts

bunx tsc --noEmit
AGENT=1 bun test test/images.test.ts
bun run lint
```

spec:
GOAL
Add the owner-only multipart photo-upload route `POST /api/listings/:id/photos` to the existing listings route module (`src/server/routes/listings.ts`) on `listingsApp`, plus a same-change `bun test` API test (`test/photos.test.ts`) — design §10 test-first cadence: the route is not done until its test exists and passes. When a listing owner POSTs a multipart body of one or more image files (each appended under one repeated field), the handler authenticates them, verifies ownership via the existing owner-guard chain, validates the `≤5` total cap, compresses EVERY file through the existing `processImage` pipeline in `src/server/images.ts`, and — only after all files pass — inserts one `listing_photos` row per file, all-or-nothing inside `withTransaction`. `position 0` is the cover: a fresh (photo-less) listing gets `position 0` for its first uploaded photo, and later uploads append at the lowest currently-free positions. `content_type` is `image/webp` and `byte_size` is the full-rendition byte length (all three from `processImage`'s `ListingImageRenditions`: `full` → `full_data`, `thumb` → `thumb_data`, `byteSize` → `byte_size`). On success the route returns 201 with the created photo rows.

CONSTRAINTS
- Build ON the existing tree — import and reuse, do NOT re-scaffold, duplicate, or modify: `src/server/images.ts` (`processImage`, `MAX_IMAGE_BYTES`, `ImageTooLargeError`, `UnsupportedImageError`), `src/server/db.ts` (`queryAll`/`queryFirst`/`queryOne`/`withTransaction`, `sql`), `src/server/auth.ts` (`sessionMiddleware`, `requireAuth`), `test/fixtures.ts` (`seedUser`, `seedSession`, `seedListing`, `seedPhoto`, `PhotoPosition`), `test/helpers.ts` (`appRequest`, `appRequestJSON`, `sessionCookieHeaders`, `queryFirst`), `test/api.setup.ts` (`setupApiTest`, `sql`). [from: spec]
- Route path is exactly `POST /api/listings/:id/photos`, owner-only, implemented on `listingsApp` in `src/server/routes/listings.ts` (mounted live at `/api/listings` by the existing `index.ts`). Do NOT create a new `routes/photos.ts` module or a second `/api` mount; do NOT touch the `GET /api/photos/:id` or `DELETE /api/photos/:id` routes (steps 31/32). [from: spec]
- Ownership semantics mirror the existing owner-only handlers in `listings.ts` (PATCH /:id, POST /:id/sold): chain `sessionMiddleware` → `requireAuth` (401 `{error: 'unauthorized'}` when `c.var.user` is null, including banned sessions) → malformed-UUID 404 guard (the module-local `UUID_PATTERN`; a non-UUID id never reaches Postgres) → ownership pre-check `SELECT l.id, l.seller_id FROM listings l JOIN users u ON u.id = l.seller_id WHERE l.id = ${id} AND u.is_banned = false`, returning 404 `{error: 'not found'}` when the row is missing, its `seller_id` is not the session user, or the seller is banned. This route never returns 403; a banned-seller listing 404s exactly like a missing id. [from: spec]
- Accept only jpeg / png / webp — no HEIC — by delegating format and size detection to `processImage` (it raises `UnsupportedImageError` for anything not jpeg/png/webp, and `ImageTooLargeError` for input > ~15 MB pre-compression). Do not re-implement format or size checks; map `UnsupportedImageError` → 400 and `ImageTooLargeError` → 400 (a distinct 413 is acceptable) with a JSON error body. [from: spec]
- Every `listing_photos` INSERT is a parameterized Bun SQL tagged template (no string interpolation of user values); `id`/`created_at` come from column defaults, and `position`/`content_type`/`full_data`/`thumb_data`/`byte_size` are bound values. `byte_size` has no column default and must be bound explicitly. [from: spec]
- Enforce the `≤5` total cap in the handler: count existing `listing_photos` rows for the listing and reject (400) if adding this batch would exceed 5 total. Never write a `position` outside 0–4 (backstopped by the `position between 0 and 4` CHECK and `unique (listing_id, position)` constraint). [from: spec]
- Success returns 201 (the in-repo create-route convention) with the created photo rows — at minimum each row's `id`, `listing_id`, `position`, `content_type`, `byte_size`. Do not invent a new mount prefix or reshape existing listing endpoints. [from: spec]
- Do not add a rate limiter (design §11 limits only login / invite-create / invite-redeem); do not ship the seller's phone anywhere in this route's response. [from: spec]
- The test runs on the dedicated `mx5_test` database via the existing `test/api.setup.ts` harness: `process.env.DATABASE_URL = 'postgresql://mx5:mx5@localhost:5432/mx5_test'` set before the dynamic imports, `await setupApiTest()`, then dynamic `await import` of `./fixtures.ts`, `./helpers.ts`, and `../src/server/index.ts` — following the exact pattern in `test/listings.test.ts` (seed the caller users/sessions once at module load). It must construct real multipart `FormData` bodies and, for the happy path, supply genuinely decodable image bytes (generate tiny PNG/JPEG/WebP buffers with `sharp`, since `processImage` decodes them). Do not batch the test to a later milestone. [from: spec]
- A single bad file (HEIC / >15 MB / undecodable) rejects the whole request with 400 and inserts nothing — validate the `≤5` cap and process EVERY file through `processImage` before any INSERT, and wrap the INSERTs in `withTransaction` so a partial batch never persists. [from: Q1]
- Multiple files are read under one repeated field: the handler collects the `File` parts from `c.req.parseBody()` in order and assigns consecutive lowest-free positions (first part → cover); the test's `FormData` is built by appending N `File` parts under the same key. [from: Q2]
- Do NOT create `routes/photos.ts`; the handler mounts on the existing `listingsApp` at `/:id/photos` (a new photos module would need a mount `index.ts` does not have). [from: spec]
- `bun test` must be run with the `AGENT=1` prefix (the repo's test script is `AGENT=1 bun test`). [from: spec]
- Bun SQL canonical import is `import {sql, type SQL} from 'bun'` — there is NO `bun:sql` module; do not import it or declare a module for it. [from: spec]

spec:
GOAL
Step 31 of the mx5-private build order (design §5 API): implement the image-serving route `GET /api/photos/:id?size=thumb|full` as a new `photosApp` Hono module in `src/server/routes/photos.ts`, mounted on the existing single `app` in `src/server/index.ts` via `app.route('/api/photos', photosApp)` ahead of the `app.get('/*')` static/SPA handler and the `app.all('/api/*')` 404 catch-all, plus its API tests in the same change per the §10 test-first cadence ("a test lands as fast as possible — in the same change — as each new route"). An anonymous `GET /api/photos/:id?size=thumb` streams the `listing_photos.thumb_data` bytea, `?size=full` streams `full_data`, and an absent `size` defaults to `full` — each with `Content-Type` taken from the row's `content_type` column and the exact header `Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable`. A malformed (non-UUID) `:id`, a nonexistent `:id`, a missing row, and an invalid `size` value all 404 with the in-repo JSON body `{error: 'not found'}`. The route is deliberately unauthenticated (no session middleware, no auth guards, no rate limiter) and never touches `users`, so no phone/seller data can appear in the response. Tests land in the same change in `test/photos-serve.test.ts` under `bun test` against `mx5_test` via the existing harness, and both `bun run test` and `bun run lint` exit 0.

spec:
GOAL
Add a `DELETE /api/photos/:id` route to the existing `photosApp` Hono instance in `src/server/routes/photos.ts` (already mounted at `/api/photos` in `src/server/index.ts` — that file is not modified) so the listing's **owner** can delete one photo and the surviving photos of that listing are re-sequenced to consecutive `position` values `0..N-1` so `position 0` is always the cover (cross-slice contract: "delete + compact remaining positions (so `position 0` is always the cover)"). The route is chained `sessionMiddleware → requireAuth` (existing exports from `src/server/auth.ts`), 401ing unauthenticated and banned-session callers with the verbatim body `{error: 'unauthorized'}`. It applies the same malformed-UUID 404 guard as the existing `GET /:id` in `photos.ts` (the module-private `UUID_PATTERN`), then performs the same ownership pre-check the other authed routes in the repo use — the photo's parent listing must exist, its `seller_id` must equal `c.var.user.id`, and the seller must not be banned (the `JOIN users … is_banned = false` filter from `listings.ts`). Inside a single `withTransaction` (from `src/server/db.ts`) the target row is deleted and all surviving rows for the same `listing_id` are re-assigned consecutive positions in ascending order of their pre-delete positions, never violating `check (position between 0 and 4)` or `unique (listing_id, position)`. Success returns 204 No Content with an empty body. A nonexistent id, a malformed (non-UUID) id, a non-owner id (any other member **and** an admin — owner-only, no admin escape), and a banned-seller id all return 404 with the verbatim body `{error: 'not found'}`; the route never returns 403. A co-located test file `test/photos-delete.test.ts` lands in the same change and passes under `bun test` against `mx5_test`.

CONSTRAINTS
- The endpoint path is exactly `DELETE /api/photos/:id` registered on the existing `photosApp` in `src/server/routes/photos.ts` (e.g. `photosApp.delete('/:id', sessionMiddleware, requireAuth, ...)`); do NOT modify `src/server/index.ts` — `photosApp` is already mounted at `/api/photos` there [from: spec]
- Owner-only, no admin escape (contract wording is "*(owner)*", unlike `DELETE /api/listings/:id` which is owner-OR-admin): the ownership guard is `row.seller_id !== c.var.user.id` → 404; do not import `requireAdmin`, do not read `c.var.user.role`, and the route never returns 403 [from: spec]
- Ownership pre-check joins up from the photo row — `SELECT l.id, l.seller_id FROM listing_photos lp JOIN listings l ON l.id = lp.listing_id JOIN users u ON u.id = l.seller_id WHERE lp.id = ${id} AND u.is_banned = false` — so a nonexistent photo, a non-owner photo, and a banned seller's photo (banned seller for EVERY caller, admins included) all 404 identically via the same `is_banned = false` filter the other routes in `listings.ts` use [from: spec]
- A malformed (non-UUID) id returns 404 `{error: 'not found'}` BEFORE any Postgres query, reusing the module-private `UUID_PATTERN` constant already in `photos.ts` (same pattern as the existing `GET /:id` in that file) [from: spec]
- The handler defensively re-checks `if (c.var.user === null) return c.json({error: 'unauthorized'}, 401)` even though `requireAuth` already 401'd (Hono middlewares don't narrow `c.var` for the next handler; the same pattern as the existing authed routes in `listings.ts`) [from: spec]
- The delete and the re-sequence run inside a single `withTransaction` from `src/server/db.ts` (atomic: commit on success, rollback on throw); the compaction re-assigns positions `0, 1, 2, …` in ascending order of the survivors' **pre-delete** positions — a positional re-index, not a content re-order (the photo at pre-delete position 1 becomes position 0 only when pre-delete position 0 is the deleted row) [from: spec]
- The `listing_photos` constraints from `0001_init.sql` hold after compaction: `position smallint … check (position between 0 and 4)` and `unique (listing_id, position)`; order the update so the unique constraint is not violated mid-update (e.g. a single CTE/`row_number()` UPDATE, or a two-pass temp-offset update) [from: spec]
- Success returns 204 with an empty body via `c.body(null, 204)`, matching the in-repo `DELETE /api/listings/:id` precedent [from: spec]
- Do NOT use `zValidator` (DELETE carries no body) and do NOT apply a rate limiter (design §11 limits only login, invite create, and invite redeem) [from: spec]
- All SQL uses Bun SQL tagged templates with bound parameters (no string interpolation of user values); the pre-check SELECT uses `queryFirst` from `src/server/db.ts` [from: spec]
- The compaction does NOT touch `listings.updated_at` (the design's "app sets `updated_at` on every UPDATE" refers to listing field edits, not photo re-sequencing) [from: spec]
- The test file `test/photos-delete.test.ts` must: set `process.env.DATABASE_URL = 'postgresql://mx5:mx5@localhost:5432/mx5_test'` at the top, BEFORE the dynamic imports; `await import('./api.setup.ts')` and call `setupApiTest()`; then dynamically import `./fixtures.ts`, `./helpers.ts`, and `../src/server/index.ts`; use `seedUser`/`seedSession`/`seedListing`/`seedPhoto` from fixtures and `appRequest`/`appRequestJSON`/`sessionCookieHeaders`/`queryFirst` from helpers; seed its own users/sessions once at module load from a phone range NOT used by existing test files (`photos.test.ts` uses +14155550460–0462, `photos-serve.test.ts` uses +14155550470 — use +14155550480 or higher); include an admin user (role `'admin'`) so the non-owner-404 case can be exercised with an admin session [from: spec]
- Do NOT modify: `src/server/index.ts`, `src/server/auth.ts`, `src/server/db.ts`, `src/server/images.ts`, `src/shared/schema.ts`, `test/fixtures.ts`, `test/helpers.ts`, `test/api.setup.ts`, `test/preload.ts`, `src/server/migrations/0001_init.sql`, or any existing test file [from: spec]
- 204 assertions MUST use raw `appRequest` (assert `res.status === 204` and `(await res.text()) === ''`); `appRequestJSON` calls `res.json()` and throws on an empty 204 body [from: spec]
- Use `import {sql} from 'bun'` (or the re-exported `sql` from `src/server/db.ts`) where a raw tagged query is needed — there is NO `bun:sql` module; do not import or declare one [from: spec]
- Code style: Prettier `.prettierrc.cjs` (printWidth 120, no semicolons, single quotes, no bracket spacing, tabWidth 4 spaces, arrowParens avoid, LF), ESLint flat config compliance (`@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any: error`, `@typescript-eslint/no-shadow: error`, unused-vars prefixed `_`), TypeScript strict mode with the project's `noUncheckedIndexedAccess` and `verbatimModuleSyntax` [from: spec]
- The test lands in the same change as the route: the route is not done until `test/photos-delete.test.ts` exists and passes under `bun test` [from: spec]

GOAL

The file opens with `@import "tailwindcss"`, then defines: a plain `@theme` block mapping every brand token onto Tailwind theme namespaces (colors → `--color-*`, fonts → `--font-*`, radii → `--radius-*`); a small `@layer base` reset; and an `@layer components` layer carrying the recurring brand classes (nav, search input + button + icon, filter chips/label/select, part card with badges + generation pill + img/body/footer, results bar, pagination, footer, form group/label/input/error, primary button + spinner, and the mockup's `@media (max-width: 768px)` block). CONSTRAINTS

[from: spec]
- Font tokens must be `--font-display: 'Hiragino Sans', 'Noto Sans JP', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif`; `--font-body: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif`; `--font-mono: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace` (the mono stack deliberately overrides Tailwind's built-in `--font-mono`). [from: spec]
- Enforce the sharp 0–4px radii posture with Tailwind radius tokens capped at 4px: `--radius-1: 1px` (badges, generation pill), `--radius-2: 2px` (cards, inputs, buttons, select, chips, page buttons), `--radius-4: 4px` (maximum). [from: spec]
- Preserve the mockups' extra literal colours as their own `--color-*` tokens, never dropping them: accent hover `oklch(58% 0.24 25)` → `--color-accent-hover`; focus/hover border `oklch(35% 0.010 260)` → `--color-focus-border`; on-accent white `oklch(100% 0 0)` → `--color-on-accent`; placeholder `oklch(40% 0.010 260)` → `--color-placeholder`. [from: spec]
- The `@theme` block is the authoritative contract: every token a later step will reference by name (`bg-bg`, `text-fg`, `border-border`, `bg-accent`, `font-mono`, `rounded-2`, …) must be declared here so it resolves to the correct namespace and value; use Tailwind v4 plain `@theme` syntax (CSS custom properties, no `@config`). Correctness therefore is judged by the `:root` custom properties in `dist/app.css`, not by the presence of the utility class rules. [from: spec]
- Do NOT build shadcn/ui components (step 36), and do NOT create `src/client/main.tsx`, `api.ts`, any page, `PartCard`, or any other `.ts`/`.tsx` file under `src/` — the deliverable is the CSS file plus its test only. [from: spec]

- Leave the login-only cinematic background out of this file — `.login-bg` (radial-gradient washes + blueprint-grid `::before` + ambient `--color-glow` `::after`) is a single-use, page-specific decorative layer; the Login page (step 40) defines it locally using the `--color-glow` token this file exposes. Port only the recurring classes in scope into `@layer components`. [from: Q1]
- In `@layer base`, write the `body` rule in raw CSS that references the Tailwind theme tokens — `body { background: var(--color-bg); color: var(--color-fg); font: 16px/1.6 var(--font-body); -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale; }` — i.e. token-driven via `var()`, not re-hardcoded literals and not `@apply`; keep `html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }` and a `box-sizing: border-box` reset in the same layer. [from: Q2]

CONSTRAINTS

[from: Q1]
- The test must assert the issued session cookie end-to-end: a login made through the `hc`-typed client returns 200 with a `Set-Cookie` of the form `session=<64-hex>; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; Path=/; Expires=...` and a body of exactly the `AuthUser` shape `{ id, phone, display_name, role, is_banned }` (no `password_hash`, no token material). [from: Q1]

spec:
GOAL
Create `src/client/hooks.ts` exporting two fully generic React hooks — `useFetch` and `useMutation` — that wrap the typed `hc<AppType>` client in `src/client/api.ts`. Each hook accepts a thunk (a zero-arg function returning the Promise of an `hc` request) and manages its own `data` / `loading` (or `isPending`) / `error` state, delegates every HTTP call to the imported `client`, and normalizes non-ok response bodies into a single `error: string | null` (flattening both the `{ error: string }` convention and the raw zod-validator `{ success: false, error: { issues: [...] } }` shape). `useFetch` fetches on mount (when `enabled !== false`), exposes `refetch`, and cancels in-flight requests on unmount via an AbortController whose signal is passed through `hc`'s `{ init: { signal } }` option. `useMutation` exposes `mutate` (resolves to the parsed JSON on success, rejects on failure), `isPending`, `error`, and `reset`. A new Playwright component test `ct/hooks.spec.tsx` mounts a new separate component file `ct/HooksTest.tsx` (default export, matching the `ct/Smoke.tsx` pattern) that exercises at least one `useFetch` and one `useMutation`, mocks the network boundary with `page.route('/api/', ...)`, asserts the loading→data and error transitions, and captures a `toHaveScreenshot` baseline. The spec file replicates the existing `typeof Bun === 'undefined'` dual-mode guard so `bun test` discovery stays intact.

- Both hooks are fully generic over a thunk returning a Promise of the `hc` request response; data types are inferred from the thunk's return (`Awaited<...>`), with no hand-written request/response interfaces, no `any`, and no `as` casts that bypass `hc` inference [from: Q2]

spec:
GOAL
Implement the member-only New listing page for `/new` in mx5-private by rewriting the placeholder `src/client/pages/NewListing.tsx` in place (no `main.tsx` change — the route is already mounted inside `RequireMember`): a "Post a Part" form collecting title, description, price (EUR, human-entered and converted to `price_cents` integer minor units), generation (na/nb/nc/nd), part type (oem/aftermarket), condition (new/used), location, OEM part number, and optional contact note, integrated with the existing `PhotoUploader` (`≤5` photos, slot 0 = cover, drafts are local, stored photos route deletion through `onDelete` → `DELETE /api/photos/:id`). Client-side validation reuses the shared zod schemas from `src/shared/schema.ts` (a failed `safeParse` renders inline `.form-error` lines and fires zero API calls). A valid submit goes through the typed `hc<AppType>` client (`useMutation` from `src/client/hooks.ts`): first `POST /api/listings` with a body shaped exactly like `listingCreateSchema` (empty/absent optionals omitted, never null), then for each pending draft photo `POST /api/listings/:id/photos` as a multipart `FormData` with the File parts under ONE repeated `photos` field (201 `{id, listing_id, position, content_type, byte_size}[]`); a post-create upload failure surfaces the normalized error string on the page (no rollback — the listing is kept, drafts stay for retry); when every selected photo is uploaded (or there were none) the page navigates to `/listing/<id>` by full page load (`window.location.assign`, the Login/Join precedent). Styling uses only the existing brand tokens/component classes from `src/client/index.css` (`.form-group`/`.form-label`/`.form-input`/`.form-error`/`.btn-primary`, mono labels, sharp 0–4px radii, katakana accents); the H1 must read exactly "New Listing" (`ct/main.spec.tsx` asserts it). The same change lands the Playwright CT spec `ct/NewListing.spec.tsx` + story `ct/NewListingStory.tsx` (mocked `page.route('/api/**')` before mount, bun-test discoverability shim, a committed `toHaveScreenshot` baseline under `ct/__screenshots__/`) following the existing `ct/` patterns, so `bun run test` passes.

CONSTRAINTS
- In-place update only: rewrite `src/client/pages/NewListing.tsx` and add `ct/NewListing.spec.tsx` / `ct/NewListingStory.tsx` + its `__screenshots__/` baseline; do NOT touch `src/client/main.tsx`, the route table, guards, `Nav`, `src/client/api.ts`, `src/client/hooks.ts`, `src/shared/schema.ts`, `src/client/components/PhotoUploader.tsx`, any server route, migration, `src/client/index.css`, or any sibling step's artifact (EditListing `/listing/:id/edit`, MyListings `/me`, Admin stay placeholders). [from: spec]
- All server↔client traffic goes through the typed `hc<AppType>` client (the hooks' `client`, or the same `client` from `src/client/api.ts` for calls the hooks can't serve): no hand-written request/response interfaces, no raw `fetch`, no `any`; request/response types are inferred from `AppType` / the shared zod types. [from: spec]
- Client-side validation reuses the shared zod schemas from `src/shared/schema.ts` (`listingCreateSchema` field limits: title 1..200, description 1..5000, `price_cents` int 0..100_000_000, `generation`/`part_type`/`condition` closed enums, `location` ≤200, `part_number` ≤100, `contact_note` ≤500); the server remains the authority — never bypass or weaken `listingCreateSchema` expectations; a failed parse renders inline `.form-error` lines and makes zero API calls. [from: spec]
- Photo flow pinned contracts: ≤5 total per listing, position 0 = cover; `PhotoUploader`'s own client-side guards (jpeg/png/webp only, 15 MB cap, verbatim error strings `'image too large (max 15 MB)'` / `'unsupported image format (jpeg, png or webp)'`) are untouched; stored-photo removal routes through `onDelete(photoId)` which the page implements as `DELETE /api/photos/:id` (server compacts positions — no client-side position math). [from: spec]
- `DELETE /api/photos/:id` is owner-only, returns 204 with an EMPTY body — the page implements `PhotoUploader.onDelete` by calling the typed client directly (`client.api.photos[':id'].$delete({param: {id}})`), checking `res.ok`, NOT through `useMutation` (whose `settleRequest` calls `res.json()` unconditionally on ok responses and would reject on success) — the direct typed-client call is the in-repo pattern (`main.tsx`'s logout). [from: spec]
- Price is EUR in minor units (`price_cents`, integer) exactly as the schema pins: the UI collects a human EUR price and converts to integer cents for the body (`Math.round(value * 100)`); never submit a float or a major-unit number as `price_cents`. [from: spec]
- The member-only guard already lives in `main.tsx` (`RequireMember` wraps `/new`); the page adds no session/redirect logic and no duplicate guard, and reads no session context. [from: spec]
- Post-create photo-upload failure is NOT a rollback: the listing is kept, the normalized error string (the hook's rejection, e.g. `'too many photos (max 5)'`, `'image too large (max 15 MB)'`, `'unsupported image format (jpeg, png or webp)'`) is surfaced on the page, and the failed drafts remain in `PhotoUploader` so the user can fix and re-submit — the listing row is never discarded and the user is never navigated away as a failure. [from: Q1]
- `location` and `part_number` render as standard optional form fields — labeled `.form-group`s with `.form-label`/`.form-input` and an "Optional" hint — visibly collectible at all times; "shown only when filled" is a read-only detail-page convention, not a form pattern; empty values are omitted from the submit body (not sent as null). [from: Q2]
- `contact_note` is collected as an optional field whose label/copy states it is shown only on contact reveal (design §4: `contact_note … shown only on contact reveal`).
- `status` is never in the create body (the schema `.default('active')` makes it omittable); `location`/`part_number`/`contact_note` are `optional()` — ABSENT, not null (nullability exists only on `listingUpdateSchema`); zod strips any client-supplied `id`/`seller_id`.
- The page H1 reads exactly "New Listing" (pinned by `ct/main.spec.tsx`); "Post a Part" is the Nav link label and must NOT be the heading.
- Post-success navigation is a FULL page load to `/listing/<id>` via `window.location.assign` (the Login/Join in-repo precedent for post-mutation navigation); the CT story is therefore the bare-component pattern (`ct/LoginStory.tsx` style: no wouter `Router`, no `SessionProvider` — the page uses no session/links/params) and the spec stubs the document navigation exactly like `ct/join.spec.tsx` (record + fulfill the `isNavigationRequest()` document request, `observing` flag set after mount).
- Photo upload trigger: uploads fire on form submit — `POST /api/listings` first, then the pending draft Files (slot order, position 0 = cover) go to `POST /api/listings/:id/photos` after the listing id is known; nothing is uploaded before the listing exists.
- The upload request body is a `FormData` with the File parts under ONE repeated field name `photos` (the server does `c.req.parseBody({all: true})` and reads `body['photos']`); it is sent as the request body with no `json` key and no manual `Content-Type`.
- Upload 400s are all-or-nothing verbatim strings: `'too many photos (max 5)'`, `'image too large (max 15 MB)'`, `'unsupported image format (jpeg, png or webp)'`, `'no photos'`; the CT mock mirrors them exactly.
- Follow repo code style: Prettier (printWidth 120, no semicolons, single quotes, arrowParens avoid, LF, 4-space indent), ESLint flat config (`no-explicit-any: error`, `no-shadow: error`, typed recommended), and `AGENTS.md` conventions (single-line one-statement ifs, no inline object types with >2 properties, named `type`s). [from: spec]
- Styling uses only existing brand tokens/classes from `src/client/index.css` (`.form-group`/`.form-label`/`.form-input`/`.form-input.error`/`.form-error`(+`.visible`)/`.btn-primary`(+`.loading` with `.btn-text`/`.btn-spinner`) plus additive inline `CSSProperties` as `ListingDetail`/`PhotoUploader` do); the theme and shadcn base are not restructured. [from: spec]

[from: spec]
- Tests land in the same change as the page (design §10 test-first cadence) — the CT spec is part of this task, not batched later.

GOAL
Implement the MyListings page at `src/client/pages/MyListings.tsx` (replacing the existing placeholder in place, keeping the named `MyListings` export and the `My Listings` heading text) so that the `/me` route renders the signed-in member's own listings as a flat `PartCard` grid (first page of `GET /api/listings?mine=1`, no pagination controls) with per-listing owner actions — Edit (wouter `Link` to `/listing/:id/edit`), Mark Sold / Undo Sold (`POST /api/listings/:id/sold` via `useMutation`, merging only the returned `status` into local state so the card dims without re-fetch), and Delete (direct typed-client `DELETE /api/listings/:id` call branching on `res.ok` since the 204 has an empty body, then removing the item from local state). The page also renders an "Invite a member" button that on click calls `POST /api/invites` (`{}` body) via `useMutation`, takes the returned `{url}`, copies it to the clipboard via `navigator.clipboard.writeText`, and shows a transient "Copied" state (or an error message if the API fails or the clipboard is unavailable). All data flows through the existing typed `hc<AppType>` client via `useFetch`/`useMutation` from `src/client/hooks.ts`; the page calls `useSession()` from `src/client/main.tsx` for owner scoping by `user.id`. The change ships with `ct/MyListingsStory.tsx` (the CT story) and `ct/MyListings.spec.tsx` (the CT spec with a committed `toHaveScreenshot` baseline), following all established CT conventions: `page.route('/api/**')` before mount, `history.pushState` to `/me` before mount, `typeof Bun === 'undefined'` guard with a bun `discoverable` fallback, and all `/api/**` mocked at the boundary (DB-free, deterministic). `bun run lint` and `bun run test` must pass.

CONSTRAINTS
- The page must remain the named `MyListings` export at `src/client/pages/MyListings.tsx`; this is an in-place content edit — never a main.tsx restructure and never a rename. [from: spec]
- The visible heading text must remain exactly "My Listings" (case- and punctuation-exact, `<h1>`) because `ct/main.spec.tsx` asserts `getByRole('heading', {name: 'My Listings'})` on the `/me` route. [from: spec]
- Do NOT touch or modify any server routes, schemas, or the `hc` client (`src/client/api.ts` / `AppType`); the API routes (`GET /api/listings?mine=1`, `POST /:id/sold`, `DELETE /:id`, `POST /api/invites`) are already built — consume them via the typed client only. [from: spec]
- All data flows through the existing typed hooks (`useFetch`/`useMutation` from `src/client/hooks.ts`) over `hc<AppType>`; no hand-written request/response interfaces, no `any`, no direct `fetch`. [from: spec]
- Delete (`DELETE /api/listings/:id`) returns 204 with an EMPTY body; `useMutation`'s `settleRequest` calls `res.json()` on every ok response and would throw on the empty body. Delete must use a direct typed-client call (the `NewListing.tsx` `handleDelete` precedent for `DELETE /api/photos/:id`): branch on `res.ok`, only read the `{error}` body on failure. [from: spec]
- Sold listings stay in the grid, greyed with the `SOLD` badge (PartCard derives this from `status === 'sold'` with opacity 0.55); do not filter them out client-side. [from: spec]
- Render only the first page of `GET /api/listings?mine=1` (page=1) with no pagination controls — no `.pagination` nav, no page state, no refetch loop. [from: Q1]
- Delete is immediate single-click with no confirmation dialog or inline confirm. [from: Q2]
- The invite link is fire-and-forget: the button creates a fresh link on each successful call (no list/revoke UI, no persisted link state). [from: spec]
- Reuse the existing brand styling and components (`PartCard`, shadcn `Button`/`Badge`, ported `index.css` classes); additive component styling only — do not edit `src/client/index.css` or `DESIGN/marketplace.html`. [from: spec]
- The `/me` route's member guard and Nav "My Parts" link already exist in `src/client/main.tsx` / `Nav.tsx` — do not alter them. [from: spec]
- The page calls `useSession()` for owner scoping; the CT story must wrap the page in `SessionProvider` (exported from `src/client/main.tsx`), which fires `GET /api/auth/me` through `hc` on mount — the mock must settle it. [from: spec]
- The page must tolerate a non-envelope `/api/listings` response body (e.g. `{ok: true}` from the full-App CT mock in `ct/main.spec.tsx`): render empty, never throw. Use the Marketplace `'items' in data` narrowing pattern. [from: spec]
- `POST /api/listings/:id/sold` returns the FULL 14-field listing row; the local state merge must take only `status` (the fetched card items lack `updated_at`/`location`/etc.). [from: spec]
- `POST /api/invites` returns exactly `{url: string}`; the body schema is `z.object({})`, so the hc call is `$post({json: {}})`. [from: spec]
- Follow the test-first cadence: the CT spec + story + screenshot baseline land in the SAME change as the page. [from: spec]
- Preserve the established CT conventions: mock `/api/**` via `page.route` BEFORE mount, push the target path with `history.pushState` before mount, deterministic fixtures, a `typeof Bun === 'undefined'` guard wrapping the Playwright tests plus a bun `discoverable` fallback test. [from: spec]
- Keep code style per the pinned Prettier/ESLint config (spaces, tabWidth 4, no semicolons, single quotes, arrowParens avoid, `no-explicit-any`/`no-shadow` errors). [from: spec]
- The owner action row (Edit + Mark Sold/Undo + Delete) must not nest `<button>`s inside the card's wrapping `<Link>`; use the ListingDetail owner-row pattern: `<Link className={buttonVariants({variant:'secondary', size:'sm'})}>` for Edit, shadcn `<Button size='sm'>` for Sold/Undo and Delete, with the error line in the mono `errorStyle`. [from: spec]
- `useMutation`'s `mutate(...)` rejects with a normalized error string; callers must `.catch(...)` to avoid unhandled rejections (the `void mutate(...).catch(() => undefined)` pattern from ListingDetail/Nav). [from: spec]
- `navigator.clipboard.writeText` in CT Chromium requires `context.grantPermissions(['clipboard-read', 'clipboard-write'], {origin})`; the spec must grant permissions before the copy test, and the page must handle the clipboard-unavailable path gracefully. [from: spec]
- The CT spec mock request bodies need the `request.postDataJSON() as Record<string, unknown>` cast pattern from `ct/NewListing.spec.tsx` (ESLint `no-explicit-any` is an error). [from: spec]

spec:
GOAL
Add the `GET /api/admin/users` endpoint (design §5 "Admin"): a new Hono route module at `src/server/routes/admin.ts` exporting `adminApp = new Hono()` with a single `GET /` route that chains the existing `sessionMiddleware` → `requireAdmin` guards and returns 200 with a flat JSON array of ALL users in the database — each element exactly `{ id, phone, display_name, role, is_banned, listing_count }`, taken from a parameterized `users LEFT JOIN listings` + `GROUP BY` so users without listings report `listing_count: 0` and no user is ever dropped. `listing_count` counts ALL listings per user regardless of status (active and sold alike — per Q1; listings are never hard-deleted, so `COUNT` over the join is the whole set), and banned sellers' listings count in their owner's total since this is the admin's moderation view. No pagination, no query params, no request body, no new zod schema. In `src/server/index.ts` chain `.route('/api/admin', adminApp)` ahead of the existing JSON `/api/*` catch-all so the route flows into the exported `AppType`. In the same change, land the `bun test` route tests in `test/admin-users.test.ts` covering the happy path (shape, listing counts incl. no-listings=0 and sold-included, banned users present) plus the guard failures (401 unauthenticated, 401 banned, 403 non-admin); the route is not done until that test passes.

CONSTRAINTS
- `listing_count` counts ALL listings per user regardless of status: `LEFT JOIN listings ON listings.seller_id = users.id`, `COUNT(*)::int`, no `WHERE status = …` filter; sold listings count, and banned sellers' listings count in their owner's total [from: Q1]
- This step creates ONLY the `GET /api/admin/users` route — do NOT implement `POST /api/admin/users/:id/ban` (step 50), the `/admin` page (step 51), or any admin listing-delete route (design: "Listing deletion reuses `DELETE /api/listings/:id`" — no separate admin route) [from: spec]
- Preserve the existing chain in `src/server/index.ts`: keep the `POST /api/_ping` throwaway, the `.route('/api/auth' | '/api/invites' | '/api/listings' | '/api/photos', …)` mounts, the GET `/*` SPA/static handler, and the final `.all('/api/*', 404)` catch-all exactly as they are; insert `.route('/api/admin', adminApp)` with the other `.route(...)` calls (ahead of `app.get('/*')` and the catch-all, or `/api/admin` requests never reach the new route) and keep `export const app` / `export type AppType = typeof app` intact [from: spec]
- Reuse `sessionMiddleware` and `requireAdmin` from `src/server/auth.ts` unchanged: 401 `{error: 'unauthorized'}` for unauthenticated and banned callers (a banned session resolves to `c.var.user === null`, so a banned admin's valid cookie hits 401, never 403), 403 `{error: 'forbidden'}` for authenticated non-admins [from: spec]
- Build the SELECT with the existing `queryAll`/`queryFirst` tagged-template helpers from `src/server/db.ts` — parameterized queries only, no string interpolation of user values; cast the aggregate as `COUNT(*)::int` (bare `COUNT(*)` returns bigint and will not type-check as `number`); no new tables, columns, or migrations [from: spec]
- Match in-repo module conventions: a module-level contract comment header and `export const adminApp = new Hono()` chained-route style (as in `listings.ts`/`photos.ts`); a NAMED type for the 6-field response row (AGENTS.md requires named types for >2-property objects); no new zod schema (no body/query to validate) [from: spec]
- No rate limiter on this route (design §11 limits only login, invite create, and invite redeem) [from: spec]
- The test file follows the established API-test boilerplate: set `process.env.DATABASE_URL = 'postgresql://mx5:mx5@localhost:5432/mx5_test'` before the dynamic imports, `await import('./api.setup.ts')` + `await setupApiTest()`, then dynamically import `./fixtures.ts`, `./helpers.ts`, and `../src/server/index.ts`; use the existing `seedUser`/`seedSession`/`seedListing` factories and pass `session.value` (not `session.cookie`) to `sessionCookieHeaders` [from: spec]
- Tests seed their own admin via `seedUser({role: 'admin', …})` — the test DB has no seeded admin (seed.ts runs only against the dev DB) — and use an unused phone range (existing tests occupy 01xx–05xx; use 06xx) [from: spec]
- The route returns a flat JSON array — no `{ items: [...] }` envelope (the listings envelope is a paginated contract this route does not have); the seeded admin themselves is included in the list (it is "all users")

ACCEPTANCE
- `GET /api/admin/users` with an admin session returns 200 and a flat JSON array in which every element has exactly the keys `id`, `phone`, `display_name`, `role`, `is_banned`, `listing_count` and no others [test: test/admin-users.test.ts "GET /api/admin/users: 200 flat array, each element exactly {id, phone, display_name, role, is_banned, listing_count}"]
- `listing_count` equals the true per-user listing total for users with listings, users with no listings report `listing_count: 0`, and a listing with `status = 'sold'` counts in its owner's total [test: test/admin-users.test.ts "listing_count counts all listings regardless of status (sold included) and is 0 for users with no listings"]
- Users with `is_banned = true` are present in the array with `is_banned: true`, and their listings still count in their own `listing_count` [test: test/admin-users.test.ts "banned users are included in the array with their listings counted"]
- The unauthenticated request is rejected: 401 with body exactly `{error: 'unauthorized'}` [test: test/admin-users.test.ts "unauthenticated caller gets 401 {error: unauthorized}"]
- A banned admin with a valid session cookie gets 401 `{error: 'unauthorized'}`, never 403 or 200 [test: test/admin-users.test.ts "banned admin with a valid session cookie gets 401, never 200 or 403"]
- An authenticated non-admin (role `member`) gets 403 with body exactly `{error: 'forbidden'}` [test: test/admin-users.test.ts "authenticated non-admin gets 403 {error: forbidden}"]
